abstract.para: CTD downcast profiles with temperature, salinity, oxygen, fluorescence, and other sensors at standard depths. 1 m-binned final data for 1993-2002 come from the SIO-CalCOFI Technical Group's own archive (J. Wilkinson), which covers the decade calcofi.org does not publish finals for; 1998 and 2003 onward come from calcofi.org. Where both publish the same cruise, calcofi.org is used; the two agree on 130 of 140 comparable files, and the four cruises that differ are recorded in question calcofi_ctd-cast_20.

dataTable.entityDescription: One row per physical sampling event at its native grain (site, tow, net, cast, bottle, underway, transect, region pool). An adjacency list: parent_sample_key points at the containing event and root_sample_key at the top of the chain, so counting distinct events at any level is a single GROUP BY.

attribute.attributeDefinition: Globally unique event key, namespaced dataset_key:sample_type:id so the same integer id in two datasets — or at two event levels in one dataset — never collides.

textDomain.definition: Globally unique event key, namespaced dataset_key:sample_type:id so the same integer id in two datasets — or at two event levels in one dataset — never collides.

attribute.attributeDefinition: Event grain: site, tow, net, cast, bottle, underway, transect or region_pool.

textDomain.definition: Event grain: site, tow, net, cast, bottle, underway, transect or region_pool.

attribute.attributeDefinition: The containing event (net → tow → site; bottle → cast). NULL at the top of the chain. Flat adjacency list: attributes are not inherited.

textDomain.definition: The containing event (net → tow → site; bottle → cast). NULL at the top of the chain. Flat adjacency list: attributes are not inherited.

attribute.attributeDefinition: Top of this event's containment chain; equals sample_key for single-level datasets. Use count(DISTINCT root_sample_key) to count stations/casts irrespective of grain.

textDomain.definition: Top of this event's containment chain; equals sample_key for single-level datasets. Use count(DISTINCT root_sample_key) to count stations/casts irrespective of grain.

attribute.attributeDefinition: CalCOFI station grid cell. NULL where the dataset has no station assignment (region-pooled phytoplankton).

textDomain.definition: CalCOFI station grid cell. NULL where the dataset has no station assignment (region-pooled phytoplankton).

attribute.attributeDefinition: CalCOFI station natural key as the source records it (line/station, e.g. 090.0 060.0). Present on 13 of the 18 source event tables, so it is carried on the event dimension rather than lost to consolidation; grid_key is the derived grid cell, this is the source's own station id.

attribute.attributeDefinition: Order in which the station was occupied on the cruise. Source spelling varies (order_occ, ord_occ) and CTD stores it as text; normalised to an integer here.
Shallowest depth sampled by this event.
Deepest depth sampled by this event.
Net gear code where the dataset records one (C1/CB/CV/PV oblique or vertical, MT manta); NULL for gears and datasets without one. Needed to compute gear-appropriate CPUE.

textDomain.definition: Net gear code where the dataset records one (C1/CB/CV/PV oblique or vertical, MT manta); NULL for gears and datasets without one. Needed to compute gear-appropriate CPUE.

attribute.attributeDefinition: The source's own processing state for this event: final (post-cruise calibrations applied) or preliminary (not for publication — the source warns that oxygen, nitrate and chlorophyll may change significantly once calibrated). Populated by calcofi_ctd-cast; NULL where the dataset draws no such distinction, which is not a claim that the data are final.

textDomain.definition: The source's own processing state for this event: final (post-cruise calibrations applied) or preliminary (not for publication — the source warns that oxygen, nitrate and chlorophyll may change significantly once calibrated). Populated by calcofi_ctd-cast; NULL where the dataset draws no such distinction, which is not a claim that the data are final.

dataTable.entityDescription: The occurrence-headline long table: one scalar measurement per row, environmental (realm = 'env') and biological (realm = 'bio') together. Biological taxon is the global taxon_key; sub-occurrence detail (length/stage bins, behavior) lives in obs_attribute, and event-level effort in sample_measurement.

attribute.attributeDefinition: Surrogate key, renumbered globally when the release concatenates the per-dataset shards.
env for physical/chemical measurements, bio for organism observations.

textDomain.definition: env for physical/chemical measurements, bio for organism observations.

attribute.attributeDefinition: The sampling event this observation came from; joins sample.

textDomain.definition: The sampling event this observation came from; joins sample.

attribute.attributeDefinition: CalCOFI station grid cell, denormalized from sample so rollups need no join. NULL for region-pooled data.

textDomain.definition: CalCOFI station grid cell, denormalized from sample so rollups need no join. NULL for region-pooled data.

attribute.attributeDefinition: Cruise, denormalized from sample so rollups need no join.

attribute.attributeDefinition: Observation time (UTC). NULL for region-pooled data with no event time.
Deepest depth this observation represents; equal to depth_min_m for point measurements (bottle, CTD scan).
Global taxon key, worms:<AphiaID> or itis:<TSN> for birds. NULL for env rows. Joins taxon.

attribute.attributeDefinition: Life stage where the source resolves one (larva, adult, juvenile, egg, phyllosoma).

H3 cell at resolution 10, stored as UBIGINT. Aggregate coarser at query time with h3_cell_to_parent(hex_id, res) — there is no per-resolution column ladder.

dataTable.entityDescription: Supplemental full-resolution CTD scans, identical in shape to obs. Excluded from the default table list and the ERD because of its size; opt in with cc_get_db(supplemental = TRUE). The default obs carries CTD via the adaptively thinned ctd_thin.
